headline: Remembering Pearl Harbor
post_facts: The U.S. declared war the next day

scenes.text: [solemnly] On this day, in nineteen forty-one... Japanese planes attacked Pearl Harbor, Hawaii.

scenes.label: Battleship Row
scenes.caption: Pearl Harbor, December 7, 1941
scenes.text: [gravely] Just before eight on a Sunday morning, hundreds of aircraft struck the Navy fleet.

scenes.label: Americans killed in the attack
scenes.text: [solemnly] More than two thousand four hundred Americans were killed.

scenes.label: USS Arizona
scenes.caption: The battleship after the attack
scenes.text: [softly] On the USS Arizona alone, one thousand one hundred seventy-seven crew members died.

scenes.title: America enters the war
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] The next day, the United States declared war on Japan.

scenes.title: We remember
scenes.text: [gently] Today, a white memorial rests above the Arizona.
[warmly] Follow On This Day USA... for a new story from history, every day.
